name: alerts_get_summary
description: Returns a compact nationwide overview of Ukraine-wide air raid and civil defense alert status and counts (total active count, affected oblasts, breakdown by alert type, and last update timestamp).

name: alerts_check_region
description: Checks whether an air raid or civil defense alert is currently active in a specific Ukrainian oblast, raion, or city (e.g. 'Kyiv', 'Харків', 'Odesa'), or pass 'Ukraine' for a nationwide summary. Omit region to use the saved default region.

region.description: Optional Ukrainian or English oblast, raion, or city name (e.g. 'Kyiv', 'Харків', 'Odesa'), or 'Ukraine' for a nationwide summary. Falls back to the saved default region if omitted.

name: alerts_list_active
description: Returns a compact paginated list of currently active alerts in Ukraine, optionally filtered by alert_type.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default 10, clamped 1..15).
